preconditions.description: The number of intersections n must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each shortcut destination a[i] must be a valid intersection number between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(a[i] <= a[i + 1] for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: The shortcuts must be in non-decreasing order.

postconditions.description: The output must be a space-separated string of integers representing the minimum energy to reach each intersection.
The energy required to reach the starting intersection (1) must be 0.
The energy required to reach any intersection must be non-negative.
